tasks.title: Cell registry 1/5: registry module, management CLI, single grid module
tasks.notes: Part of the cell-registry epic (tickets 29-33, one new branch off main, one PR; do NOT use the bakeoff-r004 branch). DESIGN (agreed in grilling session): world data lives in the active world: registry/cells.json + registry/features.json, sparse (absent cell = empty), written ONLY through one registry module (atomic write, sorted keys); LLM reads only via a documented management command. Cell record: ground none|ghost|ghost+features|generated; trees bool; decor bool; marker up|none; hold reason|null. Derived, never stored: empty, DONE, current cell (= marker cell), a cell's features. DONE = ground generated + trees + decor + every registered feature in the cell built + no marker + no open OSM-coverage warnings. Feature record: id = build slug (matches site/builds/<name>.json), name, cells touched, status planned|in-progress|built (one status per feature). Invariants enforced in code (refused write raises error naming the rule, nothing changes): single marker; ghost+features only on ghost ground; trees/decor only on generated ground; rebuilding ground clears trees+decor; reopening a feature clears trees+decor in every cell it touches. Management CLI with clear docs: query (is feature X built, what is left in cell C, status), register feature (explicit list; helper proposes OSM candidates), hold set/clear, dismiss OSM warning with reason. GRID: one cellmath module owns cell size, bounds, cell->region mapping, ring order, parse_cell and the id format; delete the other definitions (world_frame.CELL/cell_of/cell_bounds/parse_cell, coverage.cell_of/cell_bbox, pass_mask.CELL_SIZE, site_stages.CELL_SHIFT, ground_sources.mc_tile_for_cell, ref_manifest.mc_tile_id, lidar_ghost use of CELL_SHIFT). Cell id is always the string 'tx,tz' (e.g. 48,-44); 'm44' spelling only inside file names. Origin cell and cell size move into the world's world-frame.json (remove hard-coded ORIGIN_CELL in cellmath.py and CENTRE in site_status.py). Tests for all invariants. Done 2026-10-21 on cell-registry-tickets: scripts/cell_registry.py + CLI; cellmath owns grid (size/origin from world-frame cell); invariant tests; callers delegate. World checkout: config/world-frame.json cell block + empty registry/.

tasks.title: Cell registry 2/5: make build commands update the registry automatically
tasks.notes: PRINCIPLE: the registry is updated by code as a side effect of build commands, not by LLM-followed rules. ground_layer/trees_layer/decor_layer set ground/trees/decor on a clean readback only. site_kit.apply: feature status in-progress on begin, built only on clean readback (zero mismatches; mismatches stay in-progress); cells touched overwritten from the real footprint. cell_marker raise/clear sets marker (marker no longer counts as work or as a STAGES entry). lidar_ghost keeps its state machine but writes only to the registry: ghost lay-down around the marker cell (default ring 2; ground none->ghost / ghost+features); real feature apply strips ghost features first (ghost+features -> ghost); real ground apply -> generated and drops ghost features; markers never count as real work. Every block-removing command clears the matching flags in the same step: mask_undo, strip_cell_above_ground, ghost supersede/strip, site_recover. A failed apply never sets flags. Feature specs stay in site/builds/<name>.json; *-cells.json ownership files stay as block-level evidence the registry points to (not a second status record). Per-run detail (readback, snapshot, structure/from/to) goes to the existing *-result.json / *-backup.json; masks stay under verification/site/masks. Tests per writer. Done 2026-10-21 on cell-registry-tickets: registry_hooks + site_kit.apply begin/clean, cell_marker raise/clear/adopt, mask_undo, strip_cell_above_ground, site_recover rollback, lidar_ghost feature strip demotion. tasks.title: Cell registry 4/5: repair cell, whole-world backup pair, logout gate, verify
tasks.notes: repair <cell>: back up ONLY the impacted region files (region holding the cell plus any region its features/trees/decor spill into, from *-cells.json footprints and masks) together with that cell's registry record; wipe only that cell's columns to air above bedrock; replay from the registry clipped to the cell bounds (ghost ground/features if ghost state, else ground, features in registry order, trees, decor; features from site/builds specs); re-raise marker if it was up; if any step fails, clear flags for that step and all later ones so next picks it up. 'undo repair' restores the region files and the saved registry record. Bake-off: wipe the WHOLE world each round, restore ONE whole-world backup paired with a whole-registry copy (no per-cell slices); update model_bakeoff.restore_ghost_step and region_backup. Raw region_backup restore of a partial snapshot is refused (error points at the proper undo/redo command) except via repair-undo and the full-world bake-off restore. LOGOUT GATE: every command that rewrites region files (repair, undo repair, bake-off wipe/restore, dryrun_reset) refuses without --confirm-logged-out, stops and plays the need-you sound asking the user to log out; second guard checks session.lock / a running server holding the save and refuses even with the flag. VERIFY (report only, exit non-zero on any error): invariants; marker rings vs registry (exactly the marked cell has a stripe ring); region files exist for cells with ground and no blocks in cells the registry calls empty; built features have ownership files and blocks still present; registered features have specs; OSM buildings no registered feature covers (warnings that block DONE until resolved or dismissed with a reason); leftover old-system files (STAGES, QUEUE, CURRENT-CELL, sign-offs). Hook verify into scripts/run_tests.py / dryrun_reset where sensible.
